时笙最后还是按照林风的提议注册了一个佣兵队，名字用得很嚣张。

——不服来战

讲真，这么中二的名字，三人组是拒绝的，然而他们的拒绝也是没有任何效果的。

时笙最近一个月都在刷经验值，把不服来战这个名字刷到了飓风佣兵团的下面。

当然她的目标肯定是要在上面的。

众人对不服来战这个佣兵团可是很好奇。

佣兵团成员的信息除了安全区官方，是不允许公开的。

所以除了官方的人，根本就没人知道这个不服来战里到底是什么人。

任务板上刷新的任务时间显示，他们接任务不是三更半夜就是一大早，完全和其他人错开了。

你见过这么奇怪的佣兵团吗？

没有吧！

更何况这个佣兵团在短短的一个月时间就直逼飓风佣兵团。

怎么会不让人好奇。

然而事实真相却是——

清玉三人怕他们那中二病的佣兵团名字一亮出去就会被人围殴。

他们为了避开人接任务，可谓是用尽了手段。

他们容易么？

“老大有个SS级别的任务接不接？”

以前出现的任务都是S级别的，这还是第一次出现双S级别的任务。

“什么任务？”

“不清楚，说是要接了才能告诉，这任务是直接发布给排行榜的几个佣兵团的，不会出现在任务大厅。”

“不接。”时笙摇头。

这种情况，多半都是官方在玩儿什么花样。

“可是奖励很丰富啊……”林风有些可惜。

“……”说得跟她亏待了他们似的，“你缺吃的还是缺晶核？”

林风摇头，这些东西完全不缺。

他们最近趁着出任务的时候，收集了不少物资，白虎那个空间也不知道有多大，反正一直能装。

唯一不好的就是……

白虎喜欢往空间里装丧尸，就算是老大制止，它也依旧我行我素，装得不亦乐乎。

好在从白虎空间拿出来的东西，看上去没有被它装进去的丧尸污染。

“你去打听一下他们什么时候出发。”

“诶？我们不是不接吗？”

“接不接，跟你打听有关系吗？？”

Shi Sheng finally followed Lin Feng's suggestion and registered a mercenary team, using a very arrogant name.

——Fight if you don’t accept it

To be honest, the trio rejected such a middle-class name, but their rejection had no effect.

Shi Sheng has been gaining experience points in the past month, and the name Bu Fu Lai Zhan has been added to the Hurricane Mercenary Group.

Of course her goal must be above.

Everyone was very curious about the mercenary group that Bu Fei came to fight.

The information about the members of the mercenary group is not allowed to be disclosed except to the safe zone officials.

Therefore, except for the official people, no one knows who is in this dissatisfied war.

The task time refreshed on the task board showed that they received the task either in the middle of the night or early in the morning, completely different from other people.

Have you ever seen such a strange mercenary group?

No!

What's more, this mercenary group has been approaching the Hurricane mercenary group in just one month.

How could it not make people curious.

However, the truth is-

Qingyu and the others were afraid that their mercenary group would be beaten up once their names were revealed.

They tried their best to avoid people taking the mission.

Are they easy?

"Boss, there is an SS-level mission, do you want to take it?"

The missions that appeared before were all S-level, but this is the first time that a double S-level mission appears.

"What mission?"

"I don't know. I said I can't tell until I accept it. This mission is directly released to several mercenary groups in the rankings and will not appear in the mission hall."

"No answer." Shi Sheng shook his head.

In this case, most of the time the officials are playing some trick.

"But the rewards are very rich..." Lin Feng felt a little regretful.

"..." She said it as if she had treated them badly, "Are you in need of food or crystal cores?"

Lin Feng shook his head, there was no shortage of these things.

They recently took advantage of their mission to collect a lot of supplies. Bai Hu didn't know how big the space was, but he could always hold it.

The only bad thing is...

White Tiger likes to install zombies in the space. Even if the boss stops it, it will still go its own way and pretend to be happy.

Fortunately, the things taken out from the White Tiger Space did not seem to be contaminated by the zombies they contained.

"Go and find out when they will set off."

"Eh? Aren't we not going to pick it up?"

"Whether I answer it or not, does it matter to you?"
